text_block_list.text:
It's finally Уиннинг Тикит's turn to make
her
debut!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh! M-my time is here, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Th-the nerves are making my heart
pound like
crazy! I'm feeling kinda itchy
all over too!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Am I gonna be okay?! I hope I can still
run!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You're really sure! That's
reassuring,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But I guess I do feel a little braver now. I
can do
it! I'm gonna be fine!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
If I let a little thing like a debut scare
me, I'll
never make it to the Derby!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
All riiight! I'm gonna give it all I
got—FOR THE
DERBY!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
